description: Turns a polyphonic signal into polyphonic gates and triggers, channel by channel

inputs.text: The polyphonic signal being converted; a channel's gate goes high over 2V and returns low below 0.1V, and the GATE STATUS matrix shows the result

outputs.text: 10V on a channel while that input channel is over 2V, dropping to 0V once it falls below 0.1V
0V on a channel while that input channel is over 2V, rising to 10V once it falls below 0.1V
A trigger at 10V on a channel the moment that channel's gate goes high
A trigger at 10V on a channel the moment that channel's gate goes low
A trigger at 10V on a channel at both edges of that channel's gate, when it goes high and again when it goes low
